name: Woodcock Tracking with Coarse Mesh and Macrocells
definition: A volume rendering method using Woodcock tracking (null-collision) within coarse mesh elements, utilizing macrocell densities to determine the majorant extinction value.
summary: Woodcock Tracking with Coarse Mesh and Macrocells uses coarse mesh traversal and macrocell densities to compute a tighter majorant, reducing null collisions and improving performance.
